class.name: SteamRelayCoordinator
class.brief_description: Trusted game-owned backend adapter for Steam hosted dedicated relay.

method.name: _register_server
method.description: Submit the Steam-signed login only to the authenticated backend. The backend checks app, namespace, profile, virtual port and registration before acknowledging the exact request with [method SteamRelayRequest.registered] or [method SteamRelayRequest.fail].

method.name: _authorize_client
method.description: Authenticate the client independently, authorize only the selected live registration, and sign a fresh Steam relay ticket on the backend. Complete the exact request with [method SteamRelayRequest.authorize] or [method SteamRelayRequest.fail]. Keep signing credentials off client and game-server builds.

method.name: _withdraw_server
method.description: Idempotently retire only this exact generation-scoped hosted locator, including a late registration that finished after the Game left.
